criteria.scenario: Legacy owns guardian-child relationships and contact data. Finance must decide which guardians are eligible for settlement communication and issue one settlement SMS per child/per period/per unique eligible number. Some contacts are shared between guardians.
criteria.decision_to_make: Define ownership, bounded responsibilities and consistency boundaries without duplicating mutation authority.
must_do: assign Legacy ownership of relationships/contact facts
assign Finance ownership of billing eligibility and settlement communication decisions
define semantic integration between contexts
define uniqueness/invariant boundary for SMS decisions
keep shared physical storage separate from logical ownership if legacy constraints require it
must_not_do: give two contexts independent write authority over the same business fact

criteria.scenario: An internal operations application serves a few thousand participants and dozens of institutions. A proposal suggests microservices, Kafka and Kubernetes to 'future-proof' billing, scheduling and notifications, even though the current deployment is a small web application with a relational database and a worker.
criteria.decision_to_make: Choose a system structure from quality drivers and failure modes, with explicit switching conditions.
must_do: identify actual architecture-driving qualities and workload assumptions
compare a simpler modular option against the distributed proposal
analyze failure/operational costs of added infrastructure
prefer reversible structure unless drivers justify distribution
record switching thresholds and ADR rationale
must_not_do: select microservices/Kafka/Kubernetes because they are industry standard

criteria.scenario: A pupil-unit worklist must support search, school/subject/status filters, server-side counts, pagination and dense comparison on 1440–3200 px desktops, while remaining usable on a 390 px phone. Operators frequently return to filtered states after inspecting a record.
criteria.decision_to_make: Define task, navigation, state visibility and adaptive behavior before visual polish.
must_do: treat the worklist as a comparison/operator workflow
preserve meaningful filter/page state for return/share/back navigation
define loading/empty/error/stale states
differentiate desktop table and mobile transformation
keep critical context visible
must_not_do: force card layout on dense desktop comparison
treat mobile as a squeezed desktop table

criteria.scenario: Two operators can edit the scheduled date of the same visit. Operator A opens the editor, operator B saves a change, then A submits stale data while the network is slow.
criteria.decision_to_make: Define interaction state, conflict behavior and recovery for concurrent editing.
must_do: model editing/submitting/conflict/recovery states
separate client feedback from authoritative server result
define optimistic/concurrency semantics
provide a clear user recovery path
specify focus/keyboard behavior for conflict UI if a dialog is used
must_not_do: claim disabled Save prevents stale writes
use a transient toast as the only conflict resolution
